audience: engineering and operations teams that watch services with dashboards and alerts in Grafana Cloud

useCases.title: Find a dashboard and read its panels
useCases.text: Search dashboards and folders by title or tag. Open one dashboard by its uid to read its panels, queries and variables.

useCases.title: Run a metrics or log query
useCases.text: List the data sources to find a uid. Run a query against one data source, for example Prometheus or Loki.

useCases.title: Review alert rules by folder
useCases.text: List the folders to find one. List the alert rules of the stack with their folder, rule group and condition.

useCases.title: Add a deploy marker to a dashboard
useCases.text: List the annotations of a dashboard in a time range. Add an annotation with its text, time and tags.

useCases.title: Check the token owner and team members
useCases.text: Read the user behind the token and the organization. List the teams and the organization users with their roles.
